title: Mercury 3: Diffusion at scale
summary: Inception Labs 发布 Mercury 3，展示了扩散模型在大规模生成任务上的新进展与性能突破。看点在于其能否挑战主流自回归模型，并推动扩散架构在文本等领域的实用化。

title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
summary: 该帖子介绍了一种混合推理智能体框架，让 LLM 在隐空间中完成推理、再通过文本执行动作，看点在于 Together Computer 同步开源了代码与模型，并附有评测结果可验证效果。

title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
summary: MiniMax 发布 M3.1 Flash 模型，帖子主要介绍其性能表现与适用场景，看点是它在速度与成本上的定位及与其他模型的对比。

title: If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
summary: 作者主张自建 LLM 代理层，以便透明掌握模型调用、调试和成本控制，而不是把可观测性外包给第三方网关。

title: You could have invented transformers from memory
summary: 该帖子主张从“联想记忆”的直觉出发就能自行推导出Transformer架构，看点是用通俗易懂的方式揭示注意力机制背后的记忆原理。

title: Maxwell: A new kind of model that sits between code and hardware
text:
Hi HN, I'm Gal from doubleAI. We've built Maxwell, a new kind of frontier model we call a Code Execution Model.

It sits between your code and the hardware. No humans in the loop! Maxwell makes the code run faster as it runs, without ever changing a single line.

Maxwell sees programs from the inside: traces, profiling information, and the data flowing through them. It adapts dynamically to the environment, including the hardware, what else is running, and what the inputs look like.

Code execution models change the way we approach coding. Today, Claude/Codex (and humans) keep re-optimising code for every different use-case hardware and data flow (think of LLM inference engines, like vLLM!). Our bet is that this is unnecessary, suboptimal, and that it does not scale. Instead, we think the right answer is to make code a living, thinking, thing.

Early access is open at heymaxwell.ai. Happy to answer questions here.
summary: 该帖子介绍了一款名为Maxwell的“代码执行模型”，它介于代码与硬件之间，无需人工介入即可在不改动代码的前提下让程序运行得更快，通过实时分析程序内部痕迹和性能数据动态适配硬件环境。看点是提出一种全新的模型类别，宣称能自动优化代码执行效率。

title: I built a programming language that LLMs can't use
summary: 作者发明了一门故意让LLM无法生成代码的编程语言Killswitch，通过语言设计阻断AI补全，看点在于这种对抗AI辅助编程的逆向思路。

title: A new way to think about borrow checking (in reverse)
summary: 该帖子介绍了一种“反向借用检查”的新思路，即从变量生命周期的末端倒推其借用关系。看点在于它可能简化借用分析、为 Rust 等语言的借用检查器设计提供新视角。
